topics.topic: Citizenship: Acquisition methods, dual citizenship, and renunciation under 1999 Constitution
learningObjectives: Explain modes of acquiring Nigerian citizenship (birth, registration, naturalization)
Analyze constitutional qualifications and disqualifications for naturalization
Explain circumstances under which citizenship can be revoked or renounced

topics.topic: Duties and Obligations of Citizens: Paying taxes, voting, obeying laws, and defense
learningObjectives: Distinguish between civic rights and civic obligations
Explain economic consequences of tax evasion on infrastructural development
Describe national defense duties and reporting suspicious security threats

topics.topic: Democracy and National Development: Popular participation and voter apathy
learningObjectives: Define popular participation in political and community decision-making
Analyze causes of voter apathy in Nigerian general elections (rigging fears, violence, empty promises)
Propose measures to overcome voter apathy through civic sensitization

topics.topic: Human Trafficking: Causes, recruitment tricks, consequences, and NAPTIP interventions
learningObjectives: Define human trafficking and differentiate between internal and cross-border trafficking
Identify vulnerable groups (women, children) and deceitful recruitment tactics
Evaluate statutory enforcement functions of NAPTIP and rehabilitation of survivors

topics.topic: Cultism: Origin in Nigerian universities, symbols, rituals, and destructive effects
learningObjectives: Trace the historical evolution of campus confraternities into violent secret cults
Identify reasons students join secret cults (intimidation, false protection, greed)
Examine legal sanctions against cult membership and preventative strategies in schools

topics.topic: Drug Abuse and Drug Trafficking: NDLEA mandate, illicit substances, and rehabilitation
learningObjectives: Classify commonly abused substances: opioids (tramadol, codeine), cannabis, and stimulants
Analyze socio-economic and medical repercussions of drug addiction on youth
Evaluate enforcement mechanisms of NDLEA and community rehabilitation homes

topics.topic: Mid-Term Continuous Assessment & Human Rights Forum
learningObjectives: Assess pupil mastery of citizenship acquisition, voter apathy, and societal menaces
Organize an interactive symposium on eradicating cultism and substance abuse in secondary schools
Provide tailored remediation on legal processes of citizenship revocation

topics.topic: Poverty Alleviation: Government poverty alleviation programmes (NAPEP, N-Power, TraderMoni)
learningObjectives: Define poverty and differentiate between absolute and relative poverty in Nigeria
Critique successive government poverty alleviation programs from 1999 to date
Identify grassroots micro-credit models that enhance sustainable household livelihoods

topics.topic: Peace and Conflict Resolution: Meaning of peace, conflict causes, and mediation tools
learningObjectives: Distinguish between positive peace and negative peace
Identify causes of ethnic and communal conflicts in Nigeria (boundary disputes, resources)
Demonstrate non-violent conflict resolution tools: negotiation, mediation, arbitration, and litigation

topics.topic: Inter-Personal and Inter-Communal Relationships: Importance to communal harmony
learningObjectives: Define interpersonal relationships and list stages of relationship formation
Explain factors that promote communal harmony (tolerance, empathy, dialogue)
Examine the role of traditional rulers and faith-based leaders in inter-tribal peacebuilding

topics.topic: Dangers of Examination Malpractice and Countermeasures (WAEC/NECO Decrees)
learningObjectives: Identify forms of examination malpractice (leakages, impersonation, electronic cheating)
Highlight legal penalties under Examination Malpractices Act No. 33 of 1999
Foster a culture of hard work, integrity, and self-belief in academic assessments

topics.topic: Comprehensive SSS 2 Civic Education Revision & Past Paper Drill
learningObjectives: Consolidate learning on civic responsibilities, social vices, and conflict resolution
Execute timed essay responses simulating WASSCE Paper 2 Section A questions
Audit student understanding of institutional statutory mandates

topics.topic: Terminal Examination and Score Entry into Broadsheet
learningObjectives: Administer official SSS 2 end-of-term Civic Education examination
Grade answers against national standardized marking guides
Record and publish moderated terminal continuous assessment results
